body:
This isn't resolving the promise created in "query the Bluetooth cache" with the same type as that algorithm does. We probably need to add a new slot that holds a "waiting for the automation script to provide a response" promise which algorithms like that can wait for.

There's a similar problem for handling `connect()`. I would fix that example first as I'm not sure an explicit "discovery" event is exactly how we want to model this for automation.
